title: Granaticin biosynthesis and engineering: mechanistic understanding, production bottlenecks, and computational opportunities.
authors: Chen, Chang; Zhao, Bingyu; Zhu, Qiaolei; Wang, Xiaodi; Ji, Nairu; Zhu, Yunping
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦天然产物granaticin的生物合成与工程改造，虽提及蛋白结构预测等计算机会，但核心对象非蛋白质结构计算，方法贡献较弱，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Granaticin, as a member of the benzoisochromanequinone (BIQ) family, exhibits a range of biological activities, including antibacterial, antitumor, and antibiofilm effects. Notably, this compound displays a bright blue color under alkaline conditions, highlighting its potential application as a functional pigment.Although its biosynthetic gene cluster has been identified and partially characterized, efficient production of granaticin remains significantly constrained by an incomplete understanding of pathway regulation, enzymatic specificity, and metabolic flux distribution. Despite these advances, strategies for improving granaticin yield still rely largely on empirical approaches and lack predictive capability within complex biosynthetic systems. With the advancement of computational approaches-such as protein structure prediction, metabolic flux analysis, and data-driven optimization of fermentation processes-granaticin research is shifting from empirical optimization toward system-level and predictive engineering.This review systematically summarizes recent progress in granaticin research, with particular emphasis on biosynthetic mechanisms, pathway regulation, metabolic engineering strategies, tailoring enzyme functions, heterologous expression systems, and emerging computational approaches. In addition, the limitations of current engineering strategies and the major challenges associated with achieving scalable and controllable production are critically discussed.
abstract_zh: Granaticin作为苯并异色烷醌（BIQ）家族的一员，展现出多种生物活性，包括抗菌、抗肿瘤和抗生物膜作用。值得注意的是，该化合物在碱性条件下呈现亮蓝色，凸显其作为功能性色素的潜在应用价值。尽管其生物合成基因簇已被鉴定并部分表征，但granaticin的高效生产仍受到对途径调控、酶特异性和代谢通量分布理解不足的显著制约。尽管取得了这些进展，提高granaticin产量的策略仍主要依赖经验方法，在复杂生物合成系统中缺乏预测能力。随着计算方法（如蛋白质结构预测、代谢通量分析和发酵过程的数据驱动优化）的进步，granaticin研究正从经验优化转向系统级和预测性工程。本综述系统总结了granaticin研究的最新进展，特别强调生物合成机制、途径调控、代谢工程策略、修饰酶功能、异源表达系统以及新兴计算方法。此外，本文还批判性地讨论了当前工程策略的局限性以及实现可扩展和可控生产所面临的主要挑战。
